protocol.scope: exploratory TRAIN/VAL compressor feasibility; no TEST
protocol.sampling: uniform canonical TRAIN origins with replacement, seed and epoch fixed
protocol.reconstruction_training_targets: only timestamps inside original TRAIN target bounds; earlier history may condition encoder but does not contribute reconstruction loss
protocol.reconstruction_validation_scope: all canonical VAL histories after burn-in, including historical TRAIN-tail context; exploratory reconstruction selection, not independent future evaluation
protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum full VAL reconstruction MSE including epoch0; strict earliest minimum
protocol.graph: TRAIN finite-pair abs contemporaneous Pearson top3 neighbors, zero diagonal, row normalized
protocol.forecast_path: fixed E -> frozen scalar-series Bolt q0.5 -> causal D with historical latent tail
protocol.decoder_future_history: last8 observed history latent plus48 forecast latent; no actual future latent
protocol.primary_forecast_report: masked channel-macro MSE and MAE; no forecast-based checkpoint selection
protocol.cpu_limit_measurement: conservative total process CPU seconds, including Python orchestration of GPU work
